CustomField.description: The day a call-for-offers email for this deal was received. Stamped by CallForOffersStampService when an inbound call-for-offers email matches a live deal (last email wins, so a later call-for-offers email about the same deal overwrites this date). This is NOT the deal's creation date and NOT first broker contact - it replaces the proxy the call-for-offers surface previously derived from Broker_First_Seen__c/CreatedDate with the real, source-derived date. Pairs with Offer_Due_Date__c (also Date, not DateTime) on the call-for-offers table.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Date a call-for-offers email for this deal was received. Set by the inbound email pipeline, not by hand. Not the deal creation date and not first broker contact.
CustomField.label: Call For Offers Received Date
